images.title: Four lines past one
images.purpose: Pose the question: four lines from 0 end at the four marks between 1 and 2 on a number line in fifths; the student counts fifths from 0 to name each.
images.composition: One number line along the bottom with a short stack of four lines above it, all starting at 0, and one question label to the right.
images.exact_structure: A grey #6B7280 number line from 0 to 2 with exactly 11 evenly spaced ticks: each unit cut into 5 equal parts. The first gap, from 0 to the 1st tick, is shaded teal #0072B2 and labelled 1/5. The tick at 1 is reddish purple #CC79A7. Above, a stack of exactly 4 thin amber #E69F00 lines, evenly spaced, all starting exactly above 0, ending above the 6th, 7th, 8th and 9th ticks after 0. Exactly 1 number line, 4 lines.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any label on the ticks between 1 and 2, or any length written on the amber lines
images.takeaway: Keep counting fifths from 0, past 1, to name each line.
images.description: A number line from 0 to 2 in fifths with the first gap labelled 1/5 and the mark 1 labelled 5/5 = 1; four amber lines from 0 end at the four marks between 1 and 2.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count fifths from 0 to the end of the shortest amber line before naming the others.

image_decisions.why: The four lines on one fifths number line set up the count past 1 without naming the marks.
